item.description:

Why it is here: Explainer video on the environmental impact of the war in Iran, with satellite imagery and expert analysis.

The US, Israel, and Iran's war has turned the Strait of Hormuz, a key oil shipping route, into a battlefield and environmental disaster. Missiles and sea mines strike tankers, causing oil spills visible from space, damaging coastlines and marine ecosystems. Inaccessible areas due to naval blockades hinder documentation of the damage.

Data centers are central to the Senate's federal permitting overhaul debate. The Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act (BAAJA) aims to boost clean energy but faces opposition over potential fossil fuel reliance.
